Square canvas, plain white background, no text, no labels, no props, no other characters, no scenery. Input 1 is the EXACT current v7 body proportions, face construction, eye spacing and material style master. Input 2 is ONLY an outfit/hairstyle reference: the OLD WOMAN at bottom right in the B/CLUSTER row; ignore every other figure and ignore the old sheet's eye rendering.
Subject: the elderly female pedestrian from that roster, rendered in the v7 style of input 1. Silver-gray softly side-parted bob tucked behind the ears, large smooth chunky sculpted hair locks, thin rounded warm-metal spectacles with clear nonreflective lenses, subtly silver eyebrows, tiny discreet smile lines near the mouth suggesting an elderly woman without realistic skin wrinkles. Warm light skin, sweet slightly vacant gentle smile. Muted plum cardigan over ivory crewneck shirt, taupe straight full-length trousers, cream rounded walking shoes. No bag, cane, hat or jewelry. Keep the reference's huge rounded-square broad cheek head, softly flat chin, very tiny narrow low-relief nose, tiny smiling mouth. Preserve EXACT v7 eye spacing, round dark pupils subtly shifted toward the nose inside each white eye, white outer margins wider than inner margins, tiny highlights and subtle outer lashes; do not widen the eye spacing and do not center pupils. Do not make realistic eyes or porcelain doll eyes.
Body ratio is critical: hair crown to chin approximately 60% of total full-body height, chin to shoe soles 40%, huge head, very narrow tiny torso and stubby short limbs exactly like input 1; no adult body proportions, no enlarged body for age. Neutral standing reference pose, both arms relaxed slightly away from torso, hands visible, feet parallel a little apart, head level, facing camera straight on. Whole silhouette visible with white margin; top of hair at about 4% of canvas, shoe soles about 94%. Soft even studio illumination, smooth matte toy-like 3D game asset, same quality and material language as reference. ONE VIEW ONLY, no montage.
